subject: Encrypted backup escrow & DR rotation package request
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice.park@harborbank.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security_ops@harborbank.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: backup key custody, escrow & DR rotation details

Hi Soojin,

We're working through the SIG/CAIQ follow-up for our upcoming audit and need a package of artifacts related to encrypted backups for the environment that will host HarborBank production workloads. Specifically we need:

- A description of how backup encryption keys are generated and provisioned (KMS/HSM model).
- Chain-of-custody / key ceremony minutes for the most recent KEK rotation.
- Evidence of operator separation-of-duties (SoD) for key material access.
- Confirmation whether backups use tenant BYOK, Redwood-managed KMS, or HSM-wrapped keys and the vendor/model(s) involved.
- Sample rotation logs showing at least the last two rotation events and how automatic failover/DR is handled.
- Any CAIQ/SIG references or crosswalk docs that map these artifacts to questionnaire sections.

Do you have a single package we can review? We prefer a zipped package with PDF minutes, CSV rotation logs, and an access matrix. If you can also provide a short note on how disaster recovery key reconstruction is performed (and whether Shamir split or an escrow service is used) that would be very helpful.

Target for internal review is EOD Monday (Nov 30). Let me know what you can share earlier.

Thanks,

Alice Park
Senior InfoSec Manager
HarborBank
alice.park@harborbank.com

--
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@harborbank.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: backup key custody, escrow & DR rotation details

Alice — thanks for the clear checklist. We're pulling together a consolidated package and I can confirm we will provide:

- Key ceremony minutes (PDF) for the last KEK rotation and the manifest of participants.
- Rotation index (CSV) with timestamps, operator id (internal id), and associated change request ids.
- Access matrix (XLSX) showing role-based privileges for backup key operations (create/rotate/evict/reconstruct).
- HSM attestation statement describing vendor, model, and tamper-evidence status.
- A short technical note (2 pages) on DR reconstruction: we use an HSM-backed KEK with a 3-of-5 Shamir split for offline backup escrow; reconstruction requires 3 distinct roles and an offline witness process documented in the minutes.

Quick clarifications: do you need redacted operator user IDs or full internal email addresses in the rotation log? Also, would HarborBank prefer the package as a single password-protected zip or via a secure Drive folder with DocuSign for the signed minutes?

Irene is looped in for the attestation artifact. We should have a first pass ready by late today and the final package before EOD Monday.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Alice Park <alice.park@harborbank.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security_ops@harborbank.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: backup key custody, escrow & DR rotation details

Soojin — thanks, that plan sounds good. A couple of tightening requests from the audit team:

1) For rotation logs please include an immutable event id (or pointer) to the orchestration run (CI/CD job or control-plane event) that triggered the rotation. We need traceability from ticket->orchestration->KMS change.
2) For the key ceremony minutes, the auditors want a short attestation page signed by the operator leads confirming physical presence or remote witness details. DocuSign link is fine.
3) In the access matrix, label rows that indicate emergency-only procedures (e.g., emergency KEK reconstruction) vs routine operations.

On redaction: please include internal operator usernames (not full personal emails) in the CSV; auditors are satisfied with that. For delivery, HarborBank prefers a secure Drive folder (GDrive link) plus a DocuSign for the signed minutes. If you can provide a short bulleted mapping to CAIQ/SIG question IDs, that will speed our review.

If you can upload the first pass today that would be great; we can mark up and return comments by Monday morning.

Regards,

Alice

Alice / HarborBank security team — attaching the package as discussed. Links and notes below.

What we attached/uploaded:
- backup-crypto-ceremony-minutes.pdf (signed placeholder, final signatures via DocuSign): includes attendee list, witness notes, and an attestation block for operator leads.
- hsm-attestation-statement.pdf: vendor statement (Thales nShield 6000 series) and tamper-evidence summary.
- kek-rotation-index.csv: rotation events for 2025-11-01 through 2026-11-15, includes orchestration run ids and redacted operator usernames.
- backup-access-matrix.xlsx: roles, privileges, emergency flags, and SoD columns.
- caiq-sig-mapping.md: short bullets mapping artifacts to CAIQ and SIG sections (internal crosswalk).

Delivery and next steps:
- Secure Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-share (folders have restricted access; I granted HarborBank security view + comment).
- DocuSign for signed minutes: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/view?docusignId=XYZ-987654 — please sign the attestation page; the envelope will return a signed PDF that we will append to the package.
- We used a 3-of-5 Shamir split for offline escrow; reconstruction requires three distinct operator tokens and an offline witness (details in the minutes).
- Contact for follow-up: Irene Choi (irene.choi@redwoodinference.com) for technical attestation; me for process/questions.

If HarborBank needs independent HSM logs (tamper logs, audit serials) we can provide those under an MSA addendum — let us know and we'll route that request through legal.

I'll watch for signatures and any markups so we can iterate quickly.

Thanks,

Soojin Lee

Redwood Inference
